I highly recommend this clinic! Our child had never been to the dentist before, and we were worried about the pain. Before going to this clinic, we researched dental clinics all over Chiang Mai. We weren't disappointed at all! The first time was for X-rays and scaling. The most recent time was for root canal treatment and a deep filling. My child didn't feel any pain at all, not even with the anesthetic injection. My child said that having to keep their mouth open for so long hurt their jaw more! 🤣
I can vouch for the dentist's gentle touch. We were very impressed. During the treatment, the dentist was attentive, constantly asking and explaining what the next step was. They even played music for our child! 😄
